title: Directive (5/2024) concerning the regulation for formulated food
text:
ြပည်ေထာင်စုသမတြမန်မာိုင်ငံေတာ်အစိုးရ

အစားအေသာက်ှင့်ေဆးဝါးကွပ်ကဲေရးဦးစီးဌာန
description: Department of Food and Drug Administration, Ministry of Health issued the Directive no (5/2024). This directive provides for the regulations which need to follow by manufactures, producers, importers and distributors for formulated food for infants and young children.
